title.zh: 将塔克洛班市医疗中心的名称正式变更为东米沙鄢区域医疗中心的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Tacloban City Medical Center to Eastern Visayas Regional Medical Center
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Tacloban City Medical Center to Eastern Visayas Regional Medical Center
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trung tâm y tế Tacloban City thành Trung tâm y tế Eastern Visayas Regional
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อศูนย์การแพทย์ Tacloban City เป็นศูนย์การแพทย์ Eastern Visayas Regional
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Pusat Medis Tacloban City menjadi Pusat Medis Eastern Visayas Regional
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Pusat Perubatan Tacloban City menjadi Pusat Perubatan Eastern Visayas Regional

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1992/ra_7289_1992.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Tacloban City Medical Center in Tacloban City is hereby changed to Eastern Visayas Regional Medical Center.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.

titleTranslation.source: An Act Changing the Name of the Tacloban City Medical Center to Eastern Visayas Regional Medical Center
